notes.title: v0.7.0
notes.content:
- Fixed animations 
- Added flow control (right stick left or right)

notes.title: v0.5.1
notes.content:
- New Map Preview: Trail island
- New Jeans
- New bike parts! 
- Updated mechanics (suspension and friction is now dynamic!) 
- Slow motion mode (click right stick)
- Updated Tuck No Hand
- FPS restrictions to make the gameplay more constant for everyone
- Ton of small bug fixes and improvements

notes.title: v0.3.3
notes.content:
- 4 more air animations (left right forward backward)
- Physic based animated shirt
- Drive Animation (the player now goes into a drive position as faster he drives)
- New camera impulse on wheel bump
- Camera lens + motion blur reduced

notes.title: v0.2.0
notes.content:
- Completely new pedal system (you can now pedal more because a lot of you pedal'd like crazy)
- Reduced moon gravity 
- New camera effects for a better speed feeling
- Slightly increased auto leaning (will optimize this next week even more)
- Updated No Foot Can Can Animation
- Moved some ramps to make it easier for you
